core_categories: Pharmaceutical Distribution; Medical Devices; OTC Healthcare; Nutritional Supplements; Laboratory Technology and Supplies
specialty_focus: Comifar is a leading intermediate pharmaceutical distributor in Italy, part of the PHOENIX group. It operates a nationwide logistics network supplying prescription drugs, OTC items, nutritional supplements, and medical devices to thousands of pharmacies. While it distributes medical devices such as pen needles, it is not specifically focused on wearable medical devices.
